hero.fact: Built with the Government of Karnataka
hero.title: Citizen services in *their* language.
hero.line: Built with the Government of Karnataka. Newron reads Kannada handwriting, speaks in regional dialects and surfaces policy answers from documents that were never indexed — so grievance redressal works at the speed of a phone call.

sections.title: The stack behind a *working* grievance desk.
sections.line: Language, voice, triage and knowledge — assembled into one workflow that meets citizens where they are.

cards.d: Reads Kannada handwriting and print — ledger forms, applications and field notes that were never digitised.
Natural regional voices with low latency, so citizens can speak and be answered in their own dialect.
Classifies, routes, summarises and drafts a response for every grievance — at the speed of a phone call.
Surfaces the exact clause from PDFs and circulars that were never indexed, with a citation.

sections.title: From a voice note to a *resolved* case.
sections.line: Every step is logged and reviewable. Officers approve; Newron does the assembly.

steps.d: A voice note or call is transcribed and understood — no forms, no app, no English.
Category, district and the right officer tier identified automatically.
The governing rule is surfaced with its clause and current status.
A reply is drafted in the citizen's language for officer approval.

steps.label: SENT
steps.d: The approved response is delivered as natural regional speech.

sections.title: Reach the citizens a form *never* could.
sections.line: Language and literacy are the real barriers to public services. Newron reduces the reliance on English-language forms and written applications.

faq.q: Which languages and dialects are supported?
faq.a: Kannada is in production, including handwriting recognition. No other language is in production today — the stack is built to extend to other Indian languages and regional dialects, but each one needs its own data and evaluation before we would call it supported.

faq.q: Can it run inside government infrastructure?
faq.a: Yes. Newron deploys on-premise or air-gapped within state data centres, with explicit data-residency commitments and full audit trails.

faq.q: Does an officer stay in the loop?
faq.a: Always. Newron drafts and routes; a human officer reviews and approves every response before it is sent.

faq.q: How does it find answers in old circulars?
faq.a: Policy discovery indexes scanned PDFs and circulars and retrieves the exact governing clause with a citation, even when the source was never digitised.

cta.title: Bring services to *every* citizen.
cta.line: We work with state bodies to scope a pilot on a single grievance category, on your own infrastructure, with the audit trail your compliance teams require.
